comparison.objective: Release a captive latch nut with a selected wrench and open an arm; candidate preassembles a collet and nut without threading or tightening.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool-fit selection and torque versus eccentric-groove capture, tilt-and-roll insertion, and snap engagement.
comparison.success_condition: Nut backed off, arm open, damage-free hands-off hold versus retained collet surviving release and a light withdrawal check.
comparison.reason: No shared assembled state or defining manipulation. Candidate snap-force and geometry thresholds are missing, but that does not create plausible duplication.
